disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to maintain and deposit in a special account all moneys belonging to others entrusted while acting as a real estate broker
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure to maintain and deposit in a special account, separate and apart from his or her personal or other business accounts, all moneys belonging to others entrusted to him or her while acting as a real estate broker

disciplinary_grounds.description: Making substantial misrepresentations or false promises or suppression of material facts in the conduct of business
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Making substantial misrepresentations or false promises or suppression, concealment or omission of material facts in the conduct of his or her business or pursuing a flagrant and continued course of misrepresentation through agents, salespersons, advertising or otherwise in any transaction

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing within a reasonable time to account for or remit moneys or property belonging to others
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failing within a reasonable time to account for or to remit any moneys, valuable documents or other property, coming into his or her possession, which belongs to others

disciplinary_grounds.description: Representing to a lender or guaranteeing agency an amount in excess of the true sale price or terms differing from those agreed upon
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Representing to any lender, guaranteeing agency, or any other interested party, either verbally or through the preparation of false documents, an amount in excess of the true and actual sale price of the real estate or terms differing from those actually agreed upon

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to timely deliver duplicate originals of instruments to executing parties
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure to timely deliver a duplicate original of any and all instruments to any party or parties executing the same where the instruments have been prepared by the licensee or under his or her supervision or are within his or her control

disciplinary_grounds.description: Acting for more than one party in a transaction without the knowledge of all parties
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Acting for more than one party in a transaction without the knowledge of all parties for whom he or she acts, or accepting a commission or valuable consideration for services from more than one party in a real estate transaction without the knowledge of all parties to the transaction

disciplinary_grounds.description: Paying a commission or valuable consideration to any person for acts performed in violation of the chapter
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Paying a commission or valuable consideration to any person for acts or services performed in violation of sections 339.010 to 339.180 and sections 339.710 to 339.860

disciplinary_grounds.description: Guaranteeing or permitting any licensee to guarantee future profits from resale of real property
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Guaranteeing or having authorized or permitted any licensee to guarantee future profits which may result from the resale of real property

disciplinary_grounds.description: Found guilty of violating any state or federal statute governing sale or rental of real property or conduct of the real estate business
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Having been finally adjudicated and been found guilty of the violation of any state or federal statute which governs the sale or rental of real property or the conduct of the real estate business

disciplinary_grounds.description: Obtaining a certificate, permit, or license by false or fraudulent representation, fraud, or deceit
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Obtaining a certificate or registration of authority, permit or license for himself or herself or anyone else by false or fraudulent representation, fraud or deceit

disciplinary_grounds.description: Representing a real estate broker other than the broker with whom associated without express written consent
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Representing a real estate broker other than the broker with whom associated without the express written consent of the broker with whom associated

disciplinary_grounds.description: Accepting a commission from any person except the broker with whom associated at the time the commission was earned
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Accepting a commission or valuable consideration for the performance of any of the acts referred to in section 339.010 from any person except the broker with whom associated at the time the commission or valuable consideration was earned

disciplinary_grounds.description: Using prizes, gifts, or other consideration as inducement to secure customers when awarding is conditioned on purchase, or conducting lotteries to influence purchasers
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Using prizes, money, gifts or other valuable consideration as inducement to secure customers or clients to purchase, lease, sell or list property when the awarding of such prizes, money, gifts or other valuable consideration is conditioned upon the purchase, lease, sale or listing

disciplinary_grounds.description: Placing a sign on or advertising any property for sale or rent without written consent of the owner
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Placing a sign on or advertising any property offering it for sale or rent without the written consent of the owner or his or her duly authorized agent

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violation of or attempting to violate any provision of the real estate chapter or lawful rules adopted pursuant thereto
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Violation of, or attempting to violate, directly or indirectly, or assisting or enabling any person to violate, any provision of sections 339.010 to 339.180 and sections 339.710 to 339.860, or of any lawful rule adopted pursuant to sections 339.010 to 339.180 and sections 339.710 to 339.860

disciplinary_grounds.description: Committing any act which would otherwise be grounds for the commission to refuse to issue a license
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Committing any act which would otherwise be grounds for the commission to refuse to issue a license under section 339.040

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to timely inform seller of all written offers unless instructed otherwise in writing by the seller
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure to timely inform seller of all written offers unless otherwise instructed in writing by the seller

disciplinary_grounds.description: Found guilty or pled guilty/nolo contendere to a criminal offense reasonably related to the qualifications, functions, or duties of any licensed profession, or involving fraud, dishonesty, or violence
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Been finally adjudicated and found guilty, or entered a plea of guilty or nolo contendere, in a criminal prosecution under the laws of this state or any other state or of the United States, for any offense reasonably related to the qualifications, functions or duties of any profession licensed or regulated under this chapter, or for any offense an essential element of which is fraud, dishonesty or an act of violence

disciplinary_grounds.description: Any conduct constituting untrustworthy, improper, or fraudulent business dealings, bad faith, incompetence, misconduct, or gross negligence
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Any other conduct which constitutes untrustworthy, improper or fraudulent business dealings, demonstrates bad faith or incompetence, misconduct, or gross negligence

disciplinary_grounds.description: Found by a court to have used a controlled substance to the extent it impairs ability to perform the work of a licensed profession
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Been found by a court of competent jurisdiction of having used any controlled substance, as defined in chapter 195, to the extent that such use impairs a person's ability to perform the work of any profession licensed or regulated by sections 339.010 to 339.180 and sections 339.710 to 339.860

disciplinary_grounds.description: Finally adjudged insane or incompetent by a court of competent jurisdiction
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Been finally adjudged insane or incompetent by a court of competent jurisdiction

disciplinary_grounds.description: Assisting or enabling any person to practice or offer to practice a licensed profession who is not registered and currently eligible to practice
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Assisting or enabling any person to practice or offer to practice any profession licensed or regulated under sections 339.010 to 339.180 and sections 339.710 to 339.860 who is not registered and currently eligible to practice under sections 339.010 to 339.180 and sections 339.710 to 339.860

disciplinary_grounds.description: Use of any advertisement or solicitation that is knowingly false, misleading, or deceptive to the general public
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Use of any advertisement or solicitation which: (a) Is knowingly false, misleading or deceptive to the general public or persons to whom the advertisement or solicitation is primarily directed

disciplinary_grounds.description: Making any material misstatement, misrepresentation, or omission with regard to any application for licensure or license renewal
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Making any material misstatement, misrepresentation, or omission with regard to any application for licensure or license renewal.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Engaging in, committing, or assisting any person in engaging in or committing mortgage fraud
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Engaging in, committing, or assisting any person in engaging in or committing mortgage fraud, as defined in section 443.930.

definition_quote.value: A "real estate broker" is any person, partnership, limited partnership, limited liability company, association, professional corporation, or corporation, foreign or domestic who, for another, and for a compensation or valuable consideration, does, or attempts to do, any or all of the following: (1) Sells, exchanges, purchases, rents, or leases real estate; (2) Offers to sell, exchange, purchase, rent or lease real estate; (3) Negotiates or offers or agrees to negotiate the sale, exchange, purchase, rental or leasing of real estate; (4) Lists or offers or agrees to list real estate for sale, lease, rental or exchange; (5) Buys, sells, offers to buy or sell or otherwise deals in options on real estate or improvements thereon; (6) Advertises or holds himself or herself out as a licensed real estate broker while engaged in the business of buying, selling, exchanging, renting, or leasing real estate; (7) Assists or directs in the procuring of prospects, calculated to result in the sale, exchange, leasing or rental of real estate; (8) Assists or directs in the negotiation of any transaction calculated or intended to result in the sale, exchange, leasing or rental of real estate

agency_relationship_types.quote: "Single agent", a licensee who has entered into a brokerage relationship with and therefore represents only one party in a real estate transaction. A single agent may be one of the following: (a) "Buyer's agent" ... (b) "Landlord's agent" ... (c) "Seller's agent" ... (d) "Tenant's agent"

dual_agency_written_consent_required.quote: A licensee may act as a dual agent only with the consent of all parties to the transaction. Consent shall be presumed by a written agreement pursuant to section 339.780.

designated_agency_permitted.quote: A designated broker entering into a limited agency agreement with a client for the listing of property or for the purpose of representing that person in the buying, selling, exchanging, renting, or leasing of real estate may appoint in writing affiliated licensees as designated agents to the exclusion of all other affiliated licensees.

transaction_licensee_role_permitted.quote: A real estate licensee may provide real estate service to any party in a prospective transaction without an agency or fiduciary relationship to one or more parties to the transaction. Such licensee shall be called a transaction broker.

initial_interview_disclosure_required.quote: In a residential real estate transaction, at the earliest practicable opportunity during or following the first substantial contact by the designated broker or the affiliated licensees with a seller, landlord, buyer, or tenant who has not entered into a written agreement for services as described in subdivision (5) of section 339.710, the licensee shall provide that person with a written copy of the current broker disclosure form which has been prescribed by the commission.

written_service_agreement_required.quote: Before engaging in any of the activities enumerated in section 339.010, a designated broker intending to establish a limited agency relationship with a seller or landlord shall enter into a written agency agreement with the party to be represented.

escrow_account_required.quote: Each broker who holds funds belonging to another shall maintain such funds in a separate bank account in a financial institution which shall be designated an escrow or trust account.

commingling_of_funds_prohibited.quote: No broker shall commingle his or her personal funds or other funds in this account with the exception that a broker may deposit and keep a sum not to exceed one thousand dollars in the account from his or her personal funds

salesperson_broker_affiliation_required.quote: A "real estate salesperson" is any person, partnership, limited partnership, limited liability company, association, professional corporation, or corporation, domestic or foreign who for a compensation or valuable consideration becomes associated, either as an independent contractor or employee, either directly or indirectly, with a real estate broker to do any of the things above mentioned.

qualified_association_permitted.quote: Notwithstanding provisions of this chapter to the contrary, a broker may pay compensation directly to a business entity owned by a licensee that has been formed for the purpose of receiving compensation earned by such licensee.

broker_price_opinion_permitted.quote: "Broker price opinion", an opinion of value, prepared by a real estate licensee for a fee, that includes, but is not limited to, analysis of competing properties, comparable sold properties, recommended repairs and costs or suggested marketing techniques. A broker price opinion is not an appraisal and shall specifically state it is not an appraisal

comparative_market_analysis_permitted.quote: "Comparative market analysis", the analysis of sales of similar recently sold properties in order to derive an indication of the probable sales price of a particular property undertaken by a licensed real estate broker or agent, for his or her principal. A comparative market analysis is not an appraisal and shall specifically state it is not an appraisal

license_exemptions.quote: The provisions of sections 339.010 to 339.180 and sections 339.710 to 339.860 shall not apply to: (1) Any person, partnership, limited partnership, limited liability company, association, professional corporation, or corporation who as owner, lessor, or lessee shall perform any of the acts described in subsection 1 of this section with reference to property owned or leased by them, or to the regular employees thereof; (2) Any licensed attorney-at-law; (3) An auctioneer employed by the owner of the property
